content:
The most recent UEFA Champions League final was held on **Saturday, 1 June 2024**, at Wembley Stadium in London. **Real Madrid** defeated **Borussia Dortmund** **2–0**, securing their **15th Champions League title**, extending their record as the most successful club in the competition's history.

Goals were scored by **Dani Carvajal** (74') and **Vinícius Júnior** (83'). This victory marked Real Madrid’s fifth title in nine years and their second consecutive Champions League win (following their 2022 triumph).
